title: Chapter 19: Agency
paragraphs: In the classroom, Chen Mobai sat by the window, his face etched with frustration.

He had almost believed he could change his destiny. Each Azure Carp increased his Water Attribute Spiritual Root by two points. Eat a few dozen, and he could become a Heavenly Spiritual Root of Water!
But he had overlooked one crucial detail: theCultivation Assistantsoftware had detected a fluctuation in his Self-Adaptive Spiritual Power on only one day, after which it returned to normal.
Reality proved harsh.
The Azure Carp's potency lasted only a single day.
On that day, he had devoured eight carp in one go, skyrocketing his Water Attribute Spiritual Root to 39 points. The sensation during cultivation was unlike anything Chen Mobai had ever experienced.

His efficiency in absorbing Spiritual Energy had nearly doubled. This surge stemmed not only from the improved Spiritual Root attribute but also from cultivating atop a Second-Tier Water Vein. The combined effect almost tempted him to switch to theBlackwater Art.
Fortunately, Chen Mobai had always been cautious. He waited a day.
The next day, feeling uneasy, Chen Mobai used the Spiritual Power Test Strip again in the school's Cultivation Chamber. To his dismay, his Water Spiritual Root points had plummeted once more.
Refusing to accept this, he returned to the Water Abode that night and caught five Azure Carp, preparing them as sashimi.
His Water Spiritual Root points surged again, only to plummet back down after a night of cultivation.
However, there was a silver lining. Perhaps because Chen Mobai had consumed so much, the Azure Carp's power gradually enhanced his Spiritual Root.

After five days of relentless consumption, devouring nearly forty Azure Carp, Chen Mobai's Water Attribute Spiritual Root points fluctuated wildly, resembling a stock market graph, before finally stabilizing at exactly 30 points—a ceiling he couldn't surpass.
Of course, they didn't drop any lower either.
Despite the ups and downs, Chen Mobai's Water Attribute Spiritual Root points had permanently increased by 7.
Name:Chen Mobai
Cultivation Realm:Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement
Spiritual Roots:Metal 23, Wood 27, Water 30, Fire 17, Earth 10
Cultivation Art:Five Elements Art
Techniques:Lightness Technique, Cleansing Spell, Spiritual Power Shield, Qi Nourishment Technique, Water Control Spell
Chen Mobai opened the personal dashboard app on his phone, hesitated for a moment, and ultimately manually changed the Water Attribute value from 30 back to 23.
He had a growing sense that it was best to keep the matter of the Water Abode a secret.

While the Immortal Sect wasn't lacking in techniques and elixirs to enhance Spiritual Roots, few could achieve such a dramatic, immediate boost to the Water Spiritual Root attribute—nearly two or three tenths the effectiveness of the Kunpeng Dao Academy's Azure Dragon Carp.

The Azure Dragon Carp, consumed one at a time, permanently enhances a cultivator's Spiritual Root. Kunpeng Dao Academy had once used this method to cultivate a prodigiously talented Water Method Pill Refining genius from a mere 33-point ordinary Water Spiritual Root to an 80-point Heavenly Spiritual Root—a feat widely publicized by the Immortal Sect. Chen Mobai remembered daily news reports about this achievement during his childhood.

Though the Azure Carp of the Water Abode couldn't match the Azure Dragon Carp's potency, its cumulative effect had still permanently increased Chen Mobai's Water Spiritual Root attribute by 7 points. If word got out, it would undoubtedly cause a massive stir.
The Azure Dragon Carp was considered the apple of the Nascent Soul Venerable's eye, and no one had tasted one in the past two decades.
Chen Mobai wasn't dwelling on this matter. He opened his "Cultivation Assistant" app and stared at the five glowing halos circling his avatar in the upper right corner, deep in thought.
The previous night, the "Proxy" button on Turtle Gem's app had suddenly lit up and popped out. Unable to resist his curiosity, he tapped it.
Immediately, the "Cultivation Assistant" app on his phone underwent a transformation.
Five halos now circled his avatar.

Diyuan Star, though resource-scarce, faced inevitable millennial-scale wars for survival. To defend their homeland, thirty-six Heavenly Star Satellites orbited the planet, forming a colossal Grand Formation.

In peacetime, these satellites also powered the Immortal Sect's network and communications. Each satellite functioned as a supercomputer, but most of their processing power was dedicated to extracting cosmic Spiritual Energy and channeling it into every household, sustaining the cultivation efforts of three hundred million practitioners.
Consequently, to prevent computational waste, each cultivation stage granted different levels of access within each app.
For instance, Chen Mobai, at the Fifth-Stage of Qi Refinement, could only access the most basic functions of apps on his phone.
Take the Cultivation Assistant app as an illustration.

If Chen Mobai achieved Foundation Establishment, he could not only analyze his cultivation videos using the "Cultivation Assistant" software, but also request access to footage of Golden Core Venerables cultivating the Five Elements Art in the database. By comparing the two, he could correct his own cultivation errors and learn the most effective methods and subtle techniques for mastering the Five Elements Art.
The Immortal Sect's software permissions were visually represented by halos above user avatars. For example, a first-stage Qi Refinement practitioner would have a single halo.
Here was the problem:
These five halos likely indicated fifth-stage permissions!
What cultivation realm corresponded to the fifth stage?
Chen Mobai mentally calculated for a moment before drawing a sharp breath.
Holy shit, this means I've become a Soul Transformation Patriarch!
There were only two such figures in the entire Immortal Sect.
Couldn't the Turtle Shell Proxy be a little more discreet? Golden Core third-stage permissions would have been fine! Why did they give me full fifth-stage access right away?!
While Chen Mobai was inwardly panicking, in an office at the Heaven Mending Dao Academy, several cultivators were frowning at the sudden influx of data from below.
"This... Could it be that the Patriarch has awakened? Is he using an avatar to play among mortals?"
The sudden appearance of a fifth-tier user, as the developer of theCultivation Assistantsoftware, filled Mr. Shi with both excitement and apprehension.
The two patriarchs had been in seclusion for over three centuries without stirring, while his software had only been developed two centuries ago.
Although he had divided permissions into five tiers, he had only fully refined the software up to the third tier.

As his own cultivation realm was at the Golden Core stage, the next level, Nascent Soul Venerables, were exceedingly rare. Even within the Immortal Sect, there were only a dozen or so such figures, and they typically remained in seclusion for decades at a time. The only resources that could truly assist their cultivation were instructional videos and guidance from Soul Transformation Patriarchs.
Before the Soul Transformation Patriarchs began uploading their content, the highest cultivation realm that theCultivation Assistantsoftware could assist was the Golden Core stage.
Therefore, when the first fifth-tier user appeared, Mr. Shi felt a mix of excitement and dread.

"Check the user's location in the backend," the major investor, remaining remarkably calm, instructed. "Then we'll go to the site and verify their identity. It's possible a hacker has breached the software's security."
His composed demeanor immediately sobered the other cultivators, who had been scrambling to curry favor with the patriarchs.
